thread:
elaine: Quick follow-up from design review — our in-product help panel uses several different labels across the console (Runbooks vs Runbook, Help vs Docs vs Console help). Sketch attached (uploaded).

sam: Saw the screenshot. main pain: user clicks Help and lands on KB article titled 'Runbook' but the UI shows 'Runbooks' in nav. Confusing.

jess: Also noticed the search inside the panel doesn't return the same results as the global docs search. Likely different synonyms/index.

mike: Agree. We should: 1) standardize visible labels 2) add clear cross-link to full KB 3) sync search aliases.

elaine: Proposed small change: header reads `In-product docs` and subtitle `Quick help & KB links` so it's obvious this is a pointer, not the full docs site. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

sam: +1 to clarifying subtitle. UX nit: make the header a link to `/docs/console` not the current modal close area. Users try to click it to go to docs.

jess: Accessibility: please add `aria-label="In-product help: quick KB links"` to the panel container and ensure focus lands on the search input when opened. I can paste a snippet.

mike: paste please — also we need a tiny mapping table of label -> canonical doc title and search aliases. I'm thinking a 1-column CSV we can feed to the doc-indexer.

jess: ```
label,canonical_title,aliases
Runbooks,Runbook: Operational Runbook,runbook;run books;playbook
Routing policies,Traffic routing,route policies;routing
Help,Console help,help center;kb
```

docs-bot: FYI — KB indexing job picks up `aliases` from frontmatter. We can add the CSV as frontmatter entries during doc migration.

sam: For discoverability: add a tiny CTA at bottom of panel `Open full docs` that opens in a new tab and sets utm=help-panel so we can track clicks.

elaine: Good call. Product ask: can we land the label rename + aria change for the upcoming patch release? Hoping this is low-risk.

mike: Should be low-risk. I'll file a doc change PR and a tiny console tweak. Assigning to @sam and @jess for accessibility and search alias work.

jess: I'll add the aria snippet and keyboard-focus test to the accessibility checklist.

sam: I'll update the doc frontmatter CSV and notify docs@redwood.

elaine: Thanks all — will sync docs PR + small UI PR in the weekly release triage. :thumbsup:
